title: Rate entries of SAC codes
description: The ERP's reading, not a government table: for each six-digit code of Heading 9983, for the heading itself and for code 997331, the rate entry its services fall under by default. The rate notifications name headings and describe services, never six-digit codes. Explanation (ii) in paragraph 4 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) reads a heading of its Table as a heading of the annexed Scheme of Classification of Services, and the corrigenda of 30 June 2017 to Notification No. 8/2017-Integrated Tax (Rate) and Notification No. 11/2017-Union Territory Tax (Rate) read their scheme of classification of services as that Annexure, so a code's entry is the same in all three taxes. Item (ia) of serial number 21 and serial number 38 apply by what a particular supply is and are no code's default.

instruments: Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), 28 June 2017, G.S.R. 690(E), paragraph 4, Explanation (ii), with its Table and its Annexure: Scheme of Classification of Services, in force 1 July 2017
